description: BC Highways without Cell Service is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Connected Communities Branch. This KMZ file and associated map is derived from a model that identifies where there may be gaps in highway cellular coverage in B.C. and, of those gaps, where there may be power in place. The Province is providing this information to support Service Providers in understanding cellular connectivity needs in the province. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Connected Communities Branch. Its tags are highway cellular. It offers 2 resource(s) in KMZ, PDF. The portal shows 2023-11-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
